integrity: General proof uses a divisor-zeta isomorphism and compatible finite subrings; exhaustive tests of 139536 finite ordered pairs are corroboration, not proof of the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Only finite-support binary formal sums of periodic cycle classes; not chains or natural-number coefficients. The generator is not unique. No claim about arbitrary infinite intersections or principal generation of all ideals. Historical priority beyond inspected sources remains provisional.
title: Principal intersections in the binary cycle-sum ring
